steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: That wraps up your regular training for the day!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: You know, when you guys first got here, you'd be dead on the ground after just an hour or so.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Look at you now. None of you are even winded.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Just goes to show that the training did its job.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Beagle, the instructor hasn't finished yet! How could you—

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: It's fine, Fang. I'm not Dobermann. No need to follow the rules to a tee.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Everyone's exhausted after all that training. Let's take it easy. Okay?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: You know, you're starting to sound more and more like Dobermann.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Look at you. If you stand up straight, put your hands on your hips, and stare straight into my eyes, it's like you're the spitting image of Dobermann.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: And the way you talk... I guess I needn't say anymore.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: She's right. You're exactly like her~

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: It's not like back when I was in the army. Rhodes Island has a decent team of instructors who provide all reserve operators adequate training, and each of them has their specialty.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Anything that I miss, they'll notice and give you guys a lesson on that, and vice versa.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: That way, rather than leaving our reserve operators' lessons to the whim of some random person, you all receive fairly comprehensive training.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Grace, Fallon, Dobermann, and all the rest.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: You can always count on them to teach you what you need to know, and have your back in a fight.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Do your best to learn everything you can from Dobermann, okay? We wouldn't mind having a TA.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Of course, Instructor. Thank you, Instructor!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Also, remind me to find the groundskeeper to fix this place up after we're done training.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I forgot to do it before, and Dobermann tore me a new one each and every time. *Sigh*...

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Okay, Fang? Be sure to remind me.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: As you know, that wraps up our regular training for the day.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Though we still have some time left.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: And with it, I want to have a little combat drill with everyone!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Some of us here haven't been in a drill before, so I'll briefly explain what we'll be doing.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: It may sound kind of fancy, but all we are doing is simulated combat. I will evaluate your combat styles and tell you how you could improve.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: (Whispers) Quiet down. Wait till the instructor is done.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Oh, of course, this is going to be a little different than your usual fights.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Mmmhm... you're all here. Let's make this a one-on-five.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I wanted to see the results of your training and check how well all of you could work with each other anyway.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Okay, let's take a break first. Relax, eat some candy or whatever. I'll get some preparations done.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: You should relax~ It's not Dobermann we're up against.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Instructor Dur-nar isn't that usually scary, b-but... it's a different story if we're going to be fighting her!

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: You know how Instructor Dur-nar does drills with the Guard, Defender, and Vanguard operators, Lava?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Do you know what she does during those matches?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Last time, she set her shield down and bludgeoned me with two swords for a whole hour!

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: And she was as fast as the wind!

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: I used to think of her as a really friendly person. She doesn't yell at us that much, and she treats us to some really tasty food.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: It wasn't until I fought her for the first time that I found out... Once she starts walloping you, Instructor Dur-nar can be much worse than Instructor Dobermann. I could barely hold my lance up.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: And you've seen her shield arm, right? When she drops the shield and picks up a sword, she can really strike like lightning.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Oh, yeah, I think I know what you mean now. It's just like that time when I was in a shooting match against Meteor at the training grounds, right?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Hehe, she landed five training shots on me in just one minute.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Anyway, if you don't want the living daylights beat out of you, be sure to never, ever underestimate Instructor Dur-nar.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: She's a seasoned vet, and she'd still be in active service if she wasn't disillusioned with the Columbian army.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: If she brings another sword, we're as good as dead—

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Hey, Hibiscus? Did anyone go to Medical today to get some ointment or something for flesh wounds?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: We get a lot of visitors to the Medical Department every day. I guess you could say scratches and bruises are a dime a dozen there?

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Hibiscus, this is important. Work with me here.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I was redressing a patient's wound at the ward today. I wasn't in the clinic.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But I heard this from Sussurro.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Apparently everyone from A4 paid us a visit to get their wounds treated after their training this morning.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Yeah, and it was Instructor Dur-nar who brought them there.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Does that have something to do with this?

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: I can't believe not even Melantha and Cardigan could stop her...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: She might make short work of you guys one on one, but there's five of us.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: There's five of them in A4 too...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: W-What about it? We're much stronger than A4.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: We can do it! We can...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: It sounds like you guys aren't that confident. Is she really that scary?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Yeah, looks like you're all ready. Excellent.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Instructor, may I ask a question?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Why did you bring an extra practice sword?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Come on, isn't it obvious? It's for our training, of course.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Man, during the break, I suddenly remembered a combat technique I used back in the day. I really want to try it out on someone.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Oh, of course, I'll be using the same stuff as all of you. Regular training equipment, not those electric swords I modified.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: You'd better take it serious. Just because I'm not usually that hard on you guys doesn't mean I'll go easy when we're doing this for real.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: If you don't want me to wipe the floor with you, then face me.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Have you read up on the steps to intercepting the enemy? It's in your training handbook.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: When we start off, we'll be facing each other, but we'll use the whole field after that.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: What are you spacing out for? Shouldn't you be more alert with an enemy right in front of you?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Since this is our first battle, I'll let you girls attack first.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Make sure to work with each other. If you aren't careful, it's going to be no different from me taking all of you on one by one.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Beagle, keep an eye on her...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Don't have to tell me twice!

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Hibiscus, I'm counting on you to heal us up. Beagle has more pressure, so prioritize her.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Everyone, keep your eyes on her! As long as we got eyes on her, she doesn't stand a chance!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I have a clear shot on her!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Stand up, all of you. I'll go over where you went wrong.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Lava, we actually had a shot...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: But how was I supposed to know Beagle would be in the way?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Sounds like we found our problem.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: It's true that there's not much height difference in the terrain here, and those in the back could easily injure your teammates.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Aside from that, Lava, your Originium Arts are not very suitable for a closed environment like this.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: In a situation like this, you could've cast your Arts behind me to limit my movement.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Your teammates were already taking me on face to face.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: So why focus your Arts on me?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: You still haven't solved that problem we talked about.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Cardigan really likes to rock around when she's on defense. It may create more openings, but that trick is never going to work on her.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I know you fight like that because you want to play it safe, but when you can't play it safe enough to fend off disruptions, you need to use your techniques to make up for it.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Do you remember what I did just now?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: You blocked my attack and slammed my shield, and that led me into the path of Lava's Arts.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: If Fang had been faster, she could've pushed me back before I rammed into you.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Just like what Kroos did the first time.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: If you want to take my blow by yourself, however, there are three ways you can go about it.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: One, come up with a way to counter the attack and dodge it.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: This will expose your teammates to the enemy for a moment, but if you manage to take the chance and strike, you can quickly return to your defensive position.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Two, bear the impact with your shield.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Your shield is a weapon too. Right when you are about to be rammed, you can use your shield to attack.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Though you must also keep your eyes on your opponent. Don't stagger forward. You'd be giving the enemy a chance to attack your teammates or yourself when you have your back open.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: You know why I knocked you back into the path of Lava's Arts? Because you were basically begging me to do it, with your stance and your balance.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: If your defense stance was like this instead...

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: You still stepped back, but that doesn't affect Lava or Kroos's attack path in any way.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Good. You should get this down.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: You're the team captain. Your job is to command everyone else.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Tell me. How do you confirm your teammate's situations?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: You look back to check on your friends. Do you think your enemies will just let this chance slip by?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Did you guys base your positions on your basic coursework's textbook?

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: We don't follow it strictly, though.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: The battlefield is a place of chaos. Doing everything by the book is how mistakes happen.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: You need to take on some of Fang's responsibilities. Is that okay?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But what exactly should I do?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Fang needs eyes in the back of her head, and that's where you come in.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: If you, Lava, and Kroos change your positioning, you need to tell Fang.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: If anything in the environment around you changes, you need to tell her immediately, especially if it happens behind her.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: And if Fang is incapacitated, it falls on you to lead the team.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I shouldn't have shot at Hibiscus.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I'm not too familiar with what exactly ranged operators do, so I'm not going to say much.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: If we just look at how well you work with your teammates, you're doing pretty well.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Mind telling me how you're doing in the shooting practice matches just so I get a rough idea?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Meteor is usually my teacher there. She always takes me down in no time~

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: It's only been a few minutes.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: We'll be using the training grounds' obstacles next.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: This is a battlefield, and your enemies on the battlefield won't go easy on you.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I hope all of you, maybe I, will get to live for a few seconds longer.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Let's all do our best, girls.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Well, looks like I still have it in me. Awesome.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Yep, and right on time. That concludes our training for today.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Alright, how about I treat all of you to something tasty?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I got some lap cheong imported straight from Yan, marinated in the finest sauces. It's got to be the sweetest and most fragrant thing ever.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: But before that, I need to take you to Medical.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: So that we can both learn where your limits lie.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: So Cardigan and the gang didn't get sent to Medical because of you. I was so scared...

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I'm not sure about anyone else, but I've got my ways to deal with you girls. I wasn't a soldier all those years for nothing.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I had it figured out a long time ago what exactly to prioritize.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Know that a lot of actual blood and sweat, even the lives of some of my friends, went into these techniques I'm teaching you.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: If I find out you don't have this etched into your brains, I'll bring my electric blade the next time I spar.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Okay, let's get going, then. We'll get a bite to eat once you're done with your checkups.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: (What did she want me to do again?)

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Fang, you like spicy, sour stuff?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: You see, I got these snacks—

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Perfect timing. You manage the training grounds here, right?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Y-Yes, Instructor Dobermann. What's the matter?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Looks like Dur-nar and her team wrecked some of the equipment and obstacles while they were using this place. My guess is they had a pretty intense sparring match.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Help me fix it up. I'll be training with some reserve operators later tonight.
